_meta.notes: Single pilot (Valentina) in a 1-seat Mk1 pod, in orbit.
_meta.source: This fixture's flat v.crew*/v.isEVA keys are read only by CrewStatus/dual-run.test.tsx, to build its own stream emit. The '_stream' block below drives the widget: vessel.crew carries count/capacity/crew (Sitrep.Contract.VesselCrew), and vessel.identity carries vesselType=0 (Ship, not EVA), so the EVA flag reads false (matching v.isEVA above).
